title: v4.1.2 adaptive Ollama endpoint discovery and OpenClaw configuration
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; $cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path $cfg){$bak=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-config-before-049s'; if(Test-Path $bak){Remove-Item $bak -Recurse -Force}; Copy-Item $cfg $bak -Recurse -Force}; Write-Output 'V412_049S_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $ports=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]; [void]$ports.Add(11434); try{Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.LocalAddress -in @('127.0.0.1','0.0.0.0','::1','::')} | ForEach-Object {[void]$ports.Add([int]$_.LocalPort)}}catch{}; $candidates=@(); foreach($p in $ports){if($p -lt 1024 -or $p -gt 65535){continue}; try{$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:'+$p+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; $names=@($r.models | ForEach-Object {$_.name}); if($names.Count -gt 0){$candidates += [pscustomobject]@{port=$p;baseUrl=('http://127.0.0.1:'+$p);models=$names}}}catch{}}; if($candidates.Count -lt 1){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_WITH_MODELS'}; $preferred=@('qwen3:8b','qwen2.5-coder:14b','mistral-nemo','deepseek-r1:14b'); $chosen=$null; foreach($c in $candidates){foreach($m in $preferred){if(@($c.models) -contains $m){$chosen=[pscustomobject]@{baseUrl=$c.baseUrl;port=$c.port;model=$m};break}}; if($chosen){break}}; if(-not $chosen){$c=$candidates[0];$chosen=[pscustomobject]@{baseUrl=$c.baseUrl;port=$c.port;model=[string]$c.models[0]}}; $chosen | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint.json') -Encoding UTF8; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_API_KEY','ollama-local','User'); $env:OLLAMA_API_KEY='ollama-local'; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.baseUrl $chosen.baseUrl 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_BASEURL_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.api 'ollama' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_API_MODE_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.apiKey 'ollama-local' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_APIKEY_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw models set ('ollama/'+$chosen.model) 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'model-set-049s.txt') | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_MODEL_SET_FAILED'}; $chosen.model | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII; Write-Output ('V412_049S_ENDPOINT='+$chosen.baseUrl); Write-Output ('V412_049S_MODEL='+$chosen.model)
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $e=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$e.baseUrl)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_INVALID'}; if(([string]$e.baseUrl) -match '/v1'){throw 'OPENCLAW_USING_V1_ENDPOINT'}; $null=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($e.baseUrl+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop; $list=& openclaw models list --provider ollama 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_LIST_FAILED'}; $m=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Raw).Trim(); if($list -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw 'SELECTED_MODEL_NOT_VISIBLE'}; Write-Output 'V412_049S_TEST=PASS'
